propositions: set_project and remove_project accept invalid project keys (malformed syntax like 'le-g', '', '1x', trailing whitespace) with no validation, allowing invalid data to be persisted to projects.json and causing failures downstream in the reconciler

Validation must be added at write time before fsutil.atomic_write/commit_and_push_tickets_branch RMW using the existing fetcher._validate_project_key function and _PROJECT_KEY_RE regex pattern, rejecting invalid keys with a clear error and no file write

Invalid key rejection must surface as a single RebarError(returncode=2) through the library seam (_lib_ops bridge_projects_set/remove), CLI (_cli/_bridge_commands.py), and MCP write tools (_mcp_writes.py) with no traceback
Valid keys matching the regex pattern ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ must continue to be accepted and written unchanged
No network calls or Jira existence validation are added; only syntactic validation against the existing regex pattern is performed at write time
